Release process

  1. Use Conventional Commits in your branch messages.
  2. Bump the version in pyproject.toml following SemVer.
  3. Create a release tag vX.Y.Z and push the tag.
  4. Publish artifacts using the CI workflow.

docs.title: CLI
docs.text: The command-line interface is implemented under elims_instruments.cli and exposes the instruments and boards command groups.

docs.title: Commands (Mermaid flow)
docs.text:
flowchart LR
    subgraph CLI
      A[elims instruments add] --> B(InstrumentCrud.add)
      C[elims boards add] --> D(BoardCrud.add)
    end
    B --> E[Database]
    D --> E

Examples:

uv run elims instruments add scope-1 --type oscilloscope --maker Keysight \
  --model DSOX1204G --connection socket --ip-address 192.168.1.10 --port 5025

uv run elims boards add board-1 --type controller --maker Acme --model CTRL-1 \
  --connection com --com-port COM3

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
Minimal steps to set up a development environment, run tests, and try the CLI.

Prerequisites

  • Python 3.11+
  • Git

Quick setup (PowerShell)

python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate
pip install --upgrade pip
# Install the project dev tool `uv` (used in project tasks)
pip install uv
# Install project dependencies defined by the toolchain
uv install

Run the test suite

uv run pytest -q

Build the documentation

uv run mkdocs build --strict

Try the CLI

# show available command groups
uv run elims --help

# instruments group
uv run elims instruments --help

# boards group
uv run elims boards --help

Notes

  • The CLI uses a TOML database configuration file (default database.toml).
  • Example configuration is created automatically by tests; see tests/ for sample usage.
